fg.intro.text: Hi, I'm Snug! Will you help my friends' flowers bloom?

fg.back.text: Welcome back! More friends are visiting the garden.

fg.story.intro1.text: This is Snug's garden. Every friend has their own flower bed.

fg.story.intro2.text: When a friend feels understood, their flowers bloom.

fg.story.intro3.text: Today lots of friends are visiting, with lots of feelings.

fg.story.between4.text: Feelings show on faces, and in bodies too.

fg.story.between6.text: Sometimes we can do something kind to help.

fg.story.outro2.text: You noticed clues and thought about how friends feel.

fg.story.outro3.text: All feelings are OK. Here's your Bloom Badge!

fg.s.gift.text: Puff got a present! Look at her big smile. How might Puff feel?

fg.m.gift.text: Puff is smiling with her present. She might feel happy.

fg.s.icecream.text: Oh no! Bobbo's ice cream fell on the ground. How might he feel?

fg.m.icecream.text: Bobbo's ice cream fell, and his mouth turns down. He might feel sad.

fg.s.bubbles.text: Zuzu is blowing big bubbles in the sun. How might she feel?

fg.m.bubbles.text: Zuzu is smiling at her bubbles. She might feel happy.

fg.s.balloon.text: Gloop's balloon floated up and away. How might Gloop feel?

fg.m.balloon.text: Gloop's balloon flew away, and he has a tear. He might feel sad.

fg.s.swing.text: Rumble is swinging up high on the swing. How might he feel?

fg.m.swing.text: Rumble is laughing on the swing. He might feel happy.

fg.s.crayon.text: Hoot's favorite crayon snapped in two. How might Hoot feel?

fg.m.crayon.text: Hoot's crayon broke, and his eyes look down. He might feel sad.

fg.s.rainbow.text: Puff sees a big rainbow in the sky! How might Puff feel?

fg.m.rainbow.text: Puff is smiling at the rainbow. She might feel happy.

fg.s.sandcastle.text: A wave washed Zuzu's sandcastle away. How might she feel?

fg.m.sandcastle.text: Zuzu's sandcastle is gone, and she has a tear. She might feel sad.

fg.s.book.text: Gloop found his lost book under the bed! How might he feel?

fg.m.book.text: Gloop found his book, and he is smiling. He might feel happy.

fg.s.boat.text: Puff's paper boat sank in the puddle. How might Puff feel?

fg.m.boat.text: Puff's boat sank, and her mouth turns down. She might feel sad.

fg.s.music.text: Hoot is dancing to his favorite song. How might Hoot feel?

fg.m.music.text: Hoot is dancing and smiling. He might feel happy.

fg.s.thunder.text: Boom! Bobbo hears loud thunder outside. How might he feel?

fg.m.thunder.text: Bobbo's eyes are wide, and his hands are up. He might feel scared.

fg.s.popup.text: Rumble opens a box, and a toy pops out! How might he feel?

fg.m.popup.text: Rumble's eyes and mouth are big and round. He might feel surprised.

fg.s.footprint.text: Someone walked on Zuzu's drawing with muddy feet. How might she feel?

fg.m.footprint.text: Zuzu's eyebrows point down, and her hands are fists. She might feel angry.

fg.s.shell.text: Gloop found a shiny shell on the beach. How might he feel?

fg.m.shell.text: Gloop is smiling at his shell. He might feel happy.

fg.s.kite.text: Hoot's kite got stuck high up in a tree. How might he feel?

fg.m.kite.text: Hoot's kite is stuck, and his eyes look down. He might feel sad.

fg.s.dog.text: A big dog barks very loudly at Puff. How might she feel?

fg.m.dog.text: Puff is leaning back with wide eyes. She might feel scared.

fg.s.confetti.text: Whoosh! Confetti falls all over Zuzu! How might she feel?

fg.m.confetti.text: Zuzu's mouth makes a big round O. She might feel surprised.

fg.s.truck.text: Someone grabbed Bobbo's toy truck without asking. How might he feel?

fg.m.truck.text: Bobbo's eyebrows point down, and his hands are fists. He might feel angry.

fg.s.dark.text: The lights go out, and it is very dark. How might Rumble feel?

fg.m.dark.text: Rumble's eyes are wide, and he is shaking. He might feel scared.

fg.s.letter.text: Puff gets a letter with a big heart on it. How might she feel?

fg.m.letter.text: Puff is smiling at her letter. She might feel happy.

fg.s.spider.text: A spider drops down right in front of Zuzu! How might she feel?

fg.m.spider.text: Zuzu jumped back, and her eyes are wide. She might feel scared.

fg.s.cake.text: Gloop's friends made him a big birthday cake! How might he feel?

fg.m.cake.text: Gloop is smiling a big smile. He might feel happy.

fg.s.sandwich.text: Rumble dropped his sandwich in the mud. How might he feel?

fg.m.sandwich.text: Rumble's mouth turns down, and he has a tear. He might feel sad.

fg.s.blocks.text: Someone keeps knocking down Bobbo's blocks on purpose. How might he feel?

fg.m.blocks.text: Bobbo's eyebrows point down, and his hands are fists. He might feel angry.

fg.s.bee.text: A buzzy bee flies close to Puff's nose. How might she feel?

fg.m.bee.text: Puff's eyes are wide, and her hands are up. She might feel scared.

fg.s.invite.text: A friend asks Hoot to come and play. How might he feel?

fg.m.invite.text: Hoot is smiling with his wings up. He might feel happy.

fg.s.lolly.text: Zuzu's popsicle melted before she could eat it. How might she feel?

fg.m.lolly.text: Zuzu's mouth turns down, and she has a tear. She might feel sad.

fg.s.ball.text: Someone grabbed Gloop's ball and won't give it back. How might he feel?

fg.m.ball.text: Gloop's eyebrow points down, and his hands are fists. He might feel angry.

fg.s.wave.text: A huge wave rushes up the beach toward Bobbo. How might he feel?

fg.m.wave.text: Bobbo's eyes are wide, and he is leaning back. He might feel scared.

fg.s.puzzle.text: Rumble finished his big puzzle! How might he feel?

fg.m.puzzle.text: Rumble is smiling with his arms up. He might feel happy.

fg.s.tower.text: Gloop built a tall tower. Then it fell down! How might he feel?

fg.m.tower.text: Gloop worked hard on that tower. He might feel sad, or even angry.

fg.s.party.text: Bobbo opens the door, and his friends shout, 'Surprise!' How might he feel?

fg.m.party.text: A surprise party for Bobbo! He might feel surprised, and happy too.

fg.s.teddy.text: Hoot can't find his teddy anywhere. How might he feel?

fg.m.teddy.text: Hoot can't find his teddy. He might feel sad, or a bit scared.

fg.s.home.text: Time to go home, but Zuzu wants to keep playing. How might she feel?

fg.m.home.text: Zuzu has to stop playing. She might feel sad, or angry.

fg.s.fireworks.text: Bang! Big fireworks light up the sky. How might Rumble feel?

fg.m.fireworks.text: Fireworks are loud and bright. Rumble might feel surprised, scared, or happy!

fg.s.seat.text: Puff got up, and someone took her seat. How might she feel?

fg.m.seat.text: Puff's seat was taken. She might feel angry, or sad.

fg.s.drawing.text: Gloop's friend drew a picture just for him! How might he feel?

fg.m.drawing.text: A picture just for Gloop! He might feel happy, or surprised.

fg.s.wind.text: Whoosh! The wind blew Bobbo's drawing away. How might he feel?

fg.m.wind.text: Bobbo's drawing blew away. He might feel surprised, sad, or angry.

fg.s.van.text: The ice cream van drove away before Hoot got there. How might he feel?

fg.m.van.text: Hoot missed the ice cream van. He might feel sad, or angry.

fg.s.beach.text: Zuzu hears, 'We're going to the beach today!' How might she feel?

fg.m.beach.text: A beach day! Zuzu might feel happy, or surprised.

fg.s.knees.text: Rumble is hugging his knees, with his head down. How might he feel?

fg.m.knees.text: Hugging knees with a low head can mean sad, or scared.

fg.s.stomp.text: Bobbo is stomping, with his hands in tight fists. How might he feel?

fg.m.stomp.text: Tight fists and stomping feet can mean angry.

fg.s.jump.text: Zuzu is jumping, with her arms up high. How might she feel?

fg.m.jump.text: Jumping with arms up high can mean happy.

fg.s.hide.text: Gloop is shaking, with his hands over his eyes. How might he feel?

fg.m.hide.text: Shaking and hiding your eyes can mean scared, or sad.

fg.s.slump.text: Hoot's head hangs low, and his shoulders droop. How might he feel?

fg.m.slump.text: A low head and droopy shoulders can mean sad.

fg.s.crossed.text: Zuzu crosses her arms tight and stamps her foot. How might she feel?

fg.m.crossed.text: Tight crossed arms and a stamping foot can mean angry.

fg.s.leanback.text: Bobbo leans back fast, with his hands up. How might he feel?

fg.m.leanback.text: Leaning back with hands up can mean scared, or surprised.

fg.s.hugself.text: Gloop sits all alone, hugging himself. How might he feel?

fg.m.hugself.text: Sitting alone, hugging yourself, can mean sad.

fg.s.dance.text: Rumble is dancing around and waving his arms. How might he feel?

fg.m.dance.text: Dancing and waving arms can mean happy.

fg.s.wings.text: Hoot jumps, and his wings fly up wide! How might he feel?

fg.m.wings.text: A jump with wings up wide can mean surprised, or happy.

fg.s.kitebroke.text: Hoot is sad. His kite broke. What could help?

fg.m.kitebroke.text: Sitting with Hoot, or helping fix his kite, could help.

fg.s.crayons.text: Zuzu dropped all her crayons. She feels sad. What could help?

fg.m.crayons.text: Helping Zuzu pick up her crayons could help.

fg.s.alone.text: Puff is sad. Nobody is playing with her. What could help?

fg.m.alone.text: Asking Puff to play could help her feel included.

fg.s.storm.text: Gloop is scared of the thunder. What could help?

fg.m.storm.text: Sitting with Gloop, or getting a grown-up, could help.

fg.s.dropped.text: Bobbo is sad. His ice cream fell. What could help?

fg.m.dropped.text: Sharing with Bobbo, or saying something kind, could help.

fg.s.fell.text: Rumble is sad. His tower fell down. What could help?

fg.m.fell.text: Building the tower again together could help Rumble.

fg.s.newkid.text: Zuzu is new at the park. She looks worried. What could help?

fg.m.newkid.text: Asking Zuzu to play could help her feel welcome.

fg.s.knee.text: Hoot tripped and bumped his knee. What could help?

fg.m.knee.text: Asking Hoot if he's OK, or getting a grown-up, could help.

fg.s.nosnack.text: Puff forgot her snack. She feels sad. What could help?

fg.m.nosnack.text: Sharing a snack with Puff could help.

fg.s.knocked.text: Bobbo feels angry. Someone knocked his tower over. What can he do?

fg.m.knocked.text: Taking slow breaths, or telling a grown-up, are safe ideas.

fg.s.lostgame.text: Zuzu feels angry. She lost the game. What can she do?

fg.m.lostgame.text: Counting to five, or asking for a break, are calm ideas.

fg.s.laces.text: Gloop feels mad. His shoelaces keep coming undone. What can he do?

fg.m.laces.text: Taking slow breaths, or asking for help, are calm ideas.

fg.s.turn.text: Puff feels angry. Someone took her turn on the slide. What can she do?

fg.m.turn.text: Saying 'I feel mad', or telling a grown-up, are safe ideas.

fg.s.scribble.text: Hoot feels angry. Someone scribbled on his picture. What can he do?

fg.m.scribble.text: Taking slow breaths, or saying 'I feel mad', are calm ideas.

fg.s.tricky.text: Bobbo feels mad. His puzzle is very tricky. What can he do?

fg.m.tricky.text: Asking for a break, or asking for help, are calm ideas.

fg.s.queue.text: Zuzu feels mad. The line for the swing is long. What can she do?

fg.m.queue.text: Counting to five, or squeezing a calm stone, are calm ideas.

fg.s.wobbly.text: Rumble feels mad. His blocks keep falling over. What can he do?

fg.m.wobbly.text: Taking slow breaths, or asking for help, are calm ideas.

fg.s.spill.text: Puff feels angry. Her paint spilled everywhere. What can she do?

fg.m.spill.text: Squeezing a calm stone, or telling a grown-up, are calm ideas.

fg.s.firstday.text: It's Hoot's first day at a new school. How might he feel?

fg.m.firstday.text: A first day can feel nervous, and excited too. Both are OK.

fg.s.bigdrawing.text: Zuzu finished a big drawing, all by herself. How might she feel?

fg.m.bigdrawing.text: Zuzu worked hard and finished. She might feel proud, and happy.

fg.s.nofit.text: Bobbo's puzzle piece won't fit, again and again. How might he feel?

fg.m.nofit.text: When something won't work, we might feel frustrated, or angry.

fg.s.picnic.text: Puff waited all week for a picnic. Then it rained. How might she feel?

fg.m.picnic.text: Puff waited so long. She might feel disappointed, or sad.

fg.s.tag.text: Friends are playing tag, and nobody asks Gloop. How might he feel?

fg.m.tag.text: Being left out can feel lonely, or sad.

fg.s.fair.text: Rumble is going to the fair tomorrow! How might he feel?

fg.m.fair.text: Something fun is coming! Rumble might feel excited, and happy.

fg.s.bike.text: Hoot rode his bike, after trying and trying! How might he feel?

fg.m.bike.text: Hoot kept trying, and he did it! He might feel proud.

fg.s.show.text: Zuzu waits behind the curtain to sing in the show. How might she feel?

fg.m.show.text: Before a show we might feel nervous, and excited too.

fg.s.knot.text: Bobbo tries and tries, but the knot won't come undone. How might he feel?

fg.m.knot.text: When something is tricky, we might feel frustrated, or angry.

fg.s.holiday.text: Puff's best friend is away all week. How might Puff feel?

fg.m.holiday.text: Missing a friend can feel lonely, or sad.

fg.s.helper.text: Gloop wanted to be today's helper, but he wasn't picked. How might he feel?

fg.m.helper.text: Gloop hoped to help. He might feel disappointed, or sad.

fg.s.rainday.text: Rain! No picnic today. Rumble wanted a nap anyway. How might each feel?

fg.m.rainday.text: Rumble might feel happy. Puff might feel disappointed. Different feelings!

fg.s.race.text: Puff won the race, and Bobbo came last. How might each friend feel?

fg.m.race.text: Puff might feel proud. Bobbo might feel disappointed. Both are OK.

fg.s.bang.text: The fireworks start! Zuzu cheers. Rumble covers his ears. How might each friend feel?

fg.m.bang.text: Zuzu might feel excited. Rumble might feel scared. Different feelings!

fg.s.puppy.text: A puppy runs up. Gloop loves dogs. Hoot steps back. How might each feel?

fg.m.puppy.text: Gloop might feel excited. Hoot might feel nervous. Both are OK.

fg.s.cupcake.text: Bobbo got the last cupcake. Zuzu didn't get one. How might each friend feel?

fg.m.cupcake.text: Bobbo might feel happy. Zuzu might feel disappointed. Different feelings!

fg.s.pool.text: Swim time! Puff jumps in. Gloop holds the side. How might each feel?

fg.m.pool.text: Puff might feel excited. Gloop might feel nervous. Both are OK.

fg.s.ride.text: The big ride starts! Hoot loves it. Bobbo holds tight. How might each feel?

fg.m.ride.text: Hoot might feel excited. Bobbo might feel scared. Different feelings!

fg.s.crash.text: Their tower falls! Rumble laughs. Zuzu stomps. How might each friend feel?

fg.m.crash.text: Rumble might feel happy. Zuzu might feel frustrated. Both are OK.

fg.help.start.text: Look for clues: the face, the body, and what just happened.

fg.help.face.text: Eyes and mouths tell us a lot. Look closely.

fg.help.body.text: Bodies show feelings too. Tight fists can mean angry.

fg.help.situation.text: What happened to them? How would you feel?

fg.help.okay.text: All feelings are OK. It's what we do with them that matters.

fg.help.different.text: Friends can feel different about the same thing.

fg.help.kind.text: When a friend feels sad, being with them can help.

fg.help.calm.text: Big angry feelings are OK. Let's find a calm, safe idea.

fg.help.more.text: Some feelings have special names, like proud or nervous.

fg.hint.action.text: Hmm. How might {one} feel if we did that? What else could help?

fg.hint.calm.text: Big angry feelings are OK. What could {one} do that's safe?

fg.hint.model.text: Let's look at the clues together.

fg.praise.face.text: You looked closely at the face!

fg.praise.more.text: Yes, that makes sense. Friends can feel more than one way.

fg.praise.helper.text: You thought about what your friend needs.

fg.praise.safe.text: That's safe for everyone. Nice thinking!

fg.praise.different.text: You saw that they feel different things.

fg.idle.text: Tap a picture to hear it. Then bring it to our friend.

fg.pick.text: Pick a flower first. Then tap here to give it.

fg.pickcard.text: Pick an idea card first. Then tap here.

fg.breath.open.text: Let's breathe slowly with the flower.

fg.breath.how.text: Hold the flower to breathe in. Let go to breathe out.

fg.breath.tap.text: Or tap to breathe in, and tap again to breathe out.

fg.breath.done.text: Three slow breaths. Your flower is wide open!
